summary: The comment expresses concerns about screen-based instruction in schools and supports policies to reduce unnecessary screen time and provide opt-out options for parents.

claims.requested_action: Encourage reduction of screen-based instruction and provide opt-out options
claims.argument: Parents should prioritize screen-free learning and have opt-out rights
claims.evidence_quote: Parents also deserve much greater transparency and input regarding how much screen time their children are receiving at school.
